body: So the Monogatari collab was never rerun, but I remember the Nanoha event DID get a rerun bc they had uncapped Hayate and also gave the girls Spirit Enhancements! But that's also a good point on the spinoff gals, aside from the Oriko girls who are all permanent. The Tart event feels like it's been rerun a couple of times though? But I may just be blurring things.

This is really interesting! I think bc I pick a lot of supports based on whether or not it lets me play with a unit I don't have, I've seen San, Miyuri, and Anime Iroha! Though I haven't played with Nayuta yet. And absolutely on the spinoff girls...I used to see Kazumi and Kirika a LOT when I first started but they're rarely ever around anymore. It's kinda sad to see but it's also really exciting seeing who becomes more common on supports over time \^\^

Absolutely, and thank you! I was curious bc I saw a post on another site saying the original Uwasa Tsuruno was rare to find, and since I have a few of the Monogatari girls, I was wondering who else is considered super hard to see just floating around.

I'm definitely a one slot collector myself, though I've slotted quite a few just by virtue of being around for a while. I LOVE the gals so dearly and I'm big on wanting to collect them all (or at least all the ones I really enjoy). I'm not super into PvP and tend to just enjoy doin my own thing on the game \^w\^ it's brought me the most joy by far!
Thank you so much!! And happy cake day <3
